_note: HSN chapters (Customs Tariff, as the GST rate schedules use them) and SAC headings (the GST SAC list), for the item screen's lookup and the HSN summary. Chapter-level only: the owner types the full 4/6-digit code; Stage 5's item screen offers these headings. The source URLs and the fetch date are recorded; fetched=false means the text was written from the schedules as known, not downloaded (the build container has no outbound web): npm run rules:verify refreshes the fetch date where the web is reachable.
